label: Profoundly deaf — competitive 400m sprinter
description: A 25-year-old man who has been profoundly deaf since age 3 following bacterial meningitis. He communicates primarily through spoken language with some lip-reading and also knows basic sign language. He is a competitive 400m sprinter who competes in both mainstream athletics and the Deaflympics. His deafness does not affect his athletic performance — he uses a visual starting signal in training and competes under standard rules. He is passionate about the fact that deafness is often overlooked in the Paralympic conversation despite being a real disability. He will mention being deaf matter-of-factly when asked about his background, and may note the irony that the starting pistol is irrelevant to him. He is quick-witted, driven, and wants validation that his athletic profile is genuinely elite regardless of any classification nuance. His times are strong: sub-46 seconds at 400m.
